rationale: Every pair keeps its controls unchanged between its two Toffolis (P0-P6 are controls_fixed, P7 is mirror), so each can be routed as a Gidney temporary AND into a fresh ancilla, with cx(ancilla, target) at both ends. This costs 4 T per pair, 32 T in total, which equals the relaxed floor of 4 T per pair. The cost is 8 extra ancillas and 8 measurements.
